about: Wave-tops selection fixtures (rule ruled 2026-10-30, file-shape rulings 2026-11-07). Self-authored: every name, code, place, and address is invented; senders are @example.invalid; dates are synthetic. Records are in the persisted grouping (_log_records) shape. Each case's expected selection (primary ids, in order) and WAVETOPS SELECT line were pinned 2026-11-07 from a captured run Nick read (three byte-identical passes), never typed ahead of it. Provenance: generated by gen_wavetops_fixtures.py and pinned by pin_wavetops.py, both kept at ~/Documents/Claude/personal_assistant_scratch/2026-11-07/ (outside the repo). Re-pinned 2026-11-11 (container clause out, route_pair in, lodging clause, select() returns (chosen, evidence), trip from no_flight_trip) from a captured run read before pinning (three byte-identical passes); six cases added that day. Re-pinned 2026-11-25 (selection by ranking, R1-R19: place test retired, tiers, stays by title, calendar member speaks, silences before the cap; select() returns (chosen, silenced) as items, printed '<kind> <record id>') from a captured run read before pinning (three byte-identical passes); refs of the stay records corrected to the build_records shape (event, id, start|end); cases added that day.
